translations.web: From him will come the cornerstone, from him the nail, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.
translations.bsb: The cornerstone will come from Judah, the tent peg from him, as well as the battle bow and every ruler together.
translations.kjv: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.
translations.asv: From him shall come forth the corner-stone, from him the nail, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.
